snippet.title: 🎮 Heart of the Alien (Sega CD) Complete Gameplay
snippet.description:
*Heart of the Alien: Out of This World Parts I and II* is an cinematic platformer game released in 1994 for *Sega CD* . This is the direct sequel to the game Out of This World. The story picks up immediately after the ending of the first title. Now you control Buddy, the alien, who must return to the prison he once escaped from to rescue his people.

*Developer:* Interplay 
*Publisher:* Virgin 
*Release date:* 1994 
*Platform:* Sega CD / Mega CD / Sega Genesis / Mega Drive
